english.title: Make false statement or representation to secure payment of NHS charge to which not entitled
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly made a false

(A)_[statement,]_
(B)_[representation,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE STATEMENT OR REPRESENTATION.), with a view to securing for

(C)_[yourself]_
(D)_[another, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)]_

a payment under the National Health Service Act 2006 in respect of the cost of obtaining

(E)_[goods]_
(F)_[services]_

to which section 192 of that Act applied, namely **(..SPECIFY GOODS OR SERVICES..), where

(G)_[you were not]_
(H)_[that person was not]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 194(1)(c), (2)(a) and (3) of the National Health Service Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly made false statement / representation
with view to securing for self or other a payment under the Act
in respect of the cost of obtaining goods / services to which section 192 applied
when you or the other was not entitled to / the benefit of the payment

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
